extracted.intended_audience: iOS/iPadOS/tvOS users and prospective Netflix app customers
extracted.subtask_description: Product/App Store listing for the Netflix mobile/tv app describing features, system requirements, privacy practices, accessibility support, pricing, and release notes — intended to inform potential and current users about the app.

rubrics_metrics.name: Smooth navigation with bottom shortcuts
rubrics_metrics.description: Smooth navigation with bottom shortcuts to quickly browse or jump back into your favorites.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as a core usability feature — implies the app should provide persistent bottom shortcuts for fast browsing and returning to favorites.

rubrics_metrics.name: New discovery experience / upcoming clips feed
rubrics_metrics.description: A new way to discover what's next, including an upcoming clips feed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frames discovery as a distinct feature; the clips feed should surface upcoming content to help users choose what to watch next.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive entertainment in one place
rubrics_metrics.description: A full world of entertainment in one place - series, movies, live events, games, and podcasts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The app should aggregate multiple content types (video, live events, games, podcasts) to be considered a broad entertainment hub.

rubrics_metrics.name: 'My Netflix' tab / My List management
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep track of everything you love, from your favorite moments to 'My List', in the 'My Netflix' tab.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates a personalized hub where users can manage saved items and favorite moments; useful as a criterion for personalization UX.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personalized recommendations & notifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Personalized recommendations based on your ratings. Instant notifications for new releases, episodes, and live events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: App should use user signals (ratings) to generate recommendations and support timely notifications for new content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription terms and cancellation policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Netflix membership is a month-to-month subscription that begins at sign-up. You can easily cancel anytime, online, 24 hours a day. There are no long-term contracts or cancellation fees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets expectations for billing and cancellation flexibility; important for evaluating fairness/clarity of subscription terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: App Privacy — notice and verification
rubrics_metrics.description: The developer, Netflix, Inc., indicated that the app’s privacy practices may include handling of data as described below. This information has not been verified by Apple.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclosure that the developer self-reports privacy practices and Apple has not verified them; users should consult the developer's privacy policy for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data Linked to You (types & purposes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Data Linked to You: Third-Party Advertising; Location (Coarse Location); Usage Data (Product Interaction, Other Usage Data); Other Data Types; Analytics; Search History; Contact Info; Phone Number; User Content; Identifiers (User ID); Diagnostics (Crash Data, Performance Data).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists categories of data that may be collected and linked to user identity and their intended purposes (advertising, personalization, diagnostics, support). This is a criterion for privacy evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data Not Linked to You (types & purposes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Data Not Linked to You: Identifiers (Device ID); other device identifiers and data collected but not linked to identity for analytics, product personalization, and app functionality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates certain telemetry or device identifiers may be collected in anonymized form; relevant for assessing tracking vs. anonymous telemetry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy practices may vary by features or age
rubrics_metrics.description: Privacy practices may vary, for example, based on the features you use or your age.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should expect different data handling depending on app features used and account/age settings; check full privacy policy for specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility features supported
rubrics_metrics.description: The app supports: VoiceOver, Voice Control, Larger Text (increase text to 200%+), Dark Interface, Differentiate Without Color Alone, Sufficient Contrast, Reduced Motion, Captions, Audio Descriptions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as built-in accessibility support to 'help make common tasks in the app faster and easier to complete.' Use this list to evaluate compliance with common accessibility expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compatibility / minimum OS requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Compatibility: Requires iOS 18.0 or later (iPhone, iPad) and tvOS 17.0 or later (Apple TV).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines the minimum supported OS versions and devices; important for users/devs to determine whether the app will run on their hardware.

rubrics_metrics.name: Age rating and in-app content controls
rubrics_metrics.description: Age Rating: 13+. In-App Controls: Age Assurance, Parental Controls. Content descriptors include Cartoon or Fantasy Violence, Realistic Violence, Profanity or Crude Humor, Mature or Suggestive Themes, Horror/Fear Themes, Alcohol/Tobacco/Drug References, Sexual Content or Nudity, Guns or Other Weapons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these ratings and controls to assess suitability for users and to configure parental restrictions; content descriptors inform parental guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: In-App Purchases / pricing tiers
rubrics_metrics.description: In-App Purchases listed with prices (examples): Netflix 2 Screens - Unlimited Streaming $19.99; Netflix Standard $19.99; Netflix Premium $26.99; Netflix 4 Screens - Unlimited Streaming $26.99.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pricing and purchasable options are disclosed; important for evaluating cost and available subscription tiers inside the app.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contains advertising
rubrics_metrics.description: Contains Advertising: Yes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flag that the app includes advertising; relevant to user expectations and privacy/ad experience considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: App size and device support
rubrics_metrics.description: Size: 193.5 MB. Supported devices: iPhone, iPad, Apple TV.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to evaluate storage impact and device compatibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages supported
rubrics_metrics.description: Languages: English and 31 more (list includes Arabic, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Filipino, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Norwegian Bokmål, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates internationalization coverage; relevant when evaluating localization and language support for users in different regions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ratings & Reviews summary
rubrics_metrics.description: Ratings & Reviews summary: 4.7 out of 5 from 6.4M Ratings. Example user reviews are shown below the summary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aggregate rating and sample reviews provide social proof and user-reported issues/feedback; useful for qualitative assessment of app quality and common problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Version history / release-notes focus areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Release notes repeatedly report: gallery improvements, playback/player improvements, bug fixes, performance improvements, and app experience refinements (e.g., 'We’re working on the app experience. You work on what, when, and how you watch next.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use release notes to track ongoing maintenance priorities (discovery UX, playback, bug fixes, performance) and to evaluate developer responsiveness over time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developer contact and legal links
rubrics_metrics.description: Developer contact: Phone Number +18667160414, Email iosappstore@netflix.com. Links to Privacy policy, Terms of use, Developer Website, License Agreement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presence of contact info and legal links is a criterion for supportability and transparency; users should use these when reporting issues or seeking policy details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Featured In / Related apps and cross-promotion
rubrics_metrics.description: Featured In: NOW TRENDING and a list of other Netflix and third-party apps (games, tools) are presented under 'More by Netflix, Inc.' and 'You Might Also Like.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates cross-promotion and related product discovery within the App Store entry; useful when evaluating the app's ecosystem presence and marketing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright and developer attribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Copyright © 2026 Netflix. Seller: Netflix, Inc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard legal attribution for the app and developer; relevant for provenance and rights.
